title: Sausages, crushed new potatoes and spring greens

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Sausages, potatoes, greens, onions, butter and wholegrain mustard are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Everything is everyday Tesco stock, and gluten-free pork sausages are widely sold at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a saucepan and a colander, with simple boiling, frying and crushing.

works.reason: 8 sausages and 800g potatoes with a head of greens makes a sensible meal for four, and the timings for boiling, frying and wilting are sound.

honest_times.reason: Halving potatoes, slicing two onions and shredding greens fits in 20 minutes, and the 25 minutes of cooking matches the 15 to 20 minute boil running alongside the sausages.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item and seasoning is used in the steps, and 'gluten-free sausages' is still pork sausages, matching the gluten-free flag.

seasonal_feel.reason: Crushed new potatoes with spring greens is a natural late-April plate, and the potatoes are a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British steps with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Sausages with potatoes, greens and onions is a proper family dinner with plenty of vegetables.
